difficulty_reason: Characterising when a 1-morphism of stacks is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation via its 2-fibre products against (Sch/V)_fppf: part (1) represents the 2-fibre product by an algebraic space W -> V with the three properties, takes a surjective etale U -> W and factors etale coverings through U to produce etale coverings of Y by objects in the image of X; the whole construction sits in the span with only cited stability facts from Morphisms of Spaces. Retained author proof at lines 3730-3773.
